hero.tagline: IT infrastructure and security serving your company's performance.
hero.manifesto: A network outage or a security vulnerability can be costly for a business. We combine network engineering, software development and cybersecurity to build environments that are more resilient, documented and maintainable.
hero.note: An initial conversation helps define the need before any commitment.

why.title: Why choose M-SEC?
why.p1: We apply the principle of security by design. Every cable installed, every access point configured and every database deployed includes documented hardening rules, to reduce risk and simplify maintenance.
why.p2: Our architectures rely on enterprise standards: Cisco, UniFi, FortiGate. We favour verifiable choices, clear pricing and documentation delivered at every stage.

items.title: Rewiring and digitalisation of real estate complexes

segments.label: The challenge
segments.text: Major real estate complexes with a heterogeneous, slow and unreliable network, holding back management tools and points of sale.

segments.label: The solution
segments.text: Complete rewiring of nearly 50% of the network infrastructure, evaluation and deployment of management software (Okoya/Immosphere type), and integration of point-of-sale systems synchronised in real time.

segments.label: Operational impact
segments.text: Faster operations, more reliable sales and infrastructure that is finally maintainable, documented and ready to grow.

segments.label: The challenge
segments.text: A fleet of response vehicles without reliable connectivity in remote areas, unable to transmit mission data in real time.

segments.label: The solution
segments.text: Technical design and deployment of high-speed satellite terminals combined with portable power stations, to maintain an operational link independently of local infrastructure.

segments.label: Operational impact
segments.text: A better-connected fleet, more reliable telemetry and enhanced field response capacity.

sections.heading: 1. Publisher
paragraphs: The M-SEC Technology Consulting website (IT, network and cybersecurity consulting) is published by Mulume Izuba Oscar, IT developer and architect based in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

sections.heading: 2. Hosting
paragraphs: The website is hosted by GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. (88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States).
Requests sent through the forms are stored in a Supabase database, in accordance with the site's privacy policy.

sections.heading: 3. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All elements of the site (structure, texts, interfaces, logo, source code and visuals) are the exclusive property of Mulume Izuba Oscar or its rights holders. Any reproduction, representation or exploitation, in whole or in part, without prior written permission is prohibited.

sections.heading: 4. Personal data and cookies
paragraphs: Data submitted through the forms is used only to respond to your request. It is not sold. See the privacy policy and the Cookies page for details.

sections.heading: 5. Applicable law
paragraphs: This website and its use are governed by the law applicable at the publisher's place of establishment. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought before any legal action before the competent court.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the M-SEC website collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Mulume Izuba Oscar, publisher of M-SEC Technology Consulting, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Contact: oscarmulume1612@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: Through the audit, contact and pilot programme forms: name, company or restaurant, email address, phone, commune, topic, message and number of tills where applicable.
Minimal technical data (the page where the request originated) is recorded to understand the context of your message.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
paragraphs: This data is used only to respond to your request, qualify a project or review an application to the pilot programme. The legal basis is your consent, expressed by voluntarily submitting the form.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients
paragraphs: The data is accessible to the founder of M-SEC and to technical providers strictly necessary (Supabase database hosting, GitHub Pages website hosting). It is neither sold nor transferred for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Retention period
paragraphs: Requests are kept for 24 months from the last contact, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise or you request earlier deletion.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to oscarmulume1612@gmail.com. We reply within 30 days.

sections.heading: 7. Security
paragraphs: Database access is restricted. Public forms can only insert a request: no reading, modification or deletion is open to the public. Sensitive exchanges can be covered by a non-disclosure agreement.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: This website does not use any audience measurement, advertising or profiling cookies.

sections.heading: 1. Cookies
paragraphs: No cookies are set by the M-SEC website. No third-party analytics tool is loaded.

sections.heading: 2. Local storage
paragraphs: The website uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your appearance preference: automatic, light or dark. This information stays on your device and is not transmitted.

sections.heading: 3. Fonts and resources
paragraphs: The website uses the system fonts installed on your device. No font, script or external resource is loaded for display.

sections.heading: 4. Management
paragraphs: You can delete this local storage at any time through your browser settings. The website will continue to work.
